name: Hosteria Modal Gallery
author: Dolzhenkov

sections.description:
Hosteria Modal Gallery is a lightweight, responsive lightbox plugin for WordPress that automatically detects image links and displays them in a modern modal gallery powered by Swiper.js.

The plugin is designed with performance and compatibility in mind, requiring no shortcodes or manual configuration.

Features:

  • Automatically detects image links.
  • Responsive modal gallery.
  • Touch gestures and mouse wheel navigation.
  • Image zoom support.
  • Optional image captions from the alt attribute.
  • Lazy loading for improved performance.
  • Translation ready.
  • Built using WordPress Settings API.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/hosteria-modal-gallery/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Hosteria Modal Gallery from the WordPress dashboard to configure plugin options.
sections.faq:
Does the plugin require shortcodes?

No. It automatically detects image links on the page.

Can I display image captions?

Yes. Enable the option in the plugin settings to display captions from the image alt attribute.
